players.name: Brock Purdy
players.note: Kyle Shanahan ruled him out (ankle) for the Nov. 29 game at Seattle on Friday, Nov. 27, and Mac Jones will start. Shanahan said Purdy does not need surgery and the team hopes he returns in Week 13.

players.name: Mac Jones
players.note: He starts for San Francisco at Seattle on Nov. 29 after Brock Purdy (ankle) was ruled out on Friday, Nov. 27. Purdy is hoped to return in Week 13.

players.name: Justin Herbert
players.note: He was ruled out for the Nov. 29 game vs. New England on Friday, Nov. 27 after failing to clear the concussion protocol. DJ Uiagalelei will make his first NFL start.

players.name: DJ Uiagalelei
players.note: Jim Harbaugh named him the Week 12 starter on Friday, Nov. 27 with Justin Herbert (concussion) out. He makes his first NFL start Nov. 29 vs. the Patriots, with Jake Browning as the backup.

players.name: Carson Beck
players.note: Arizona ruled him out (back spasms) for the Nov. 29 game vs. Washington, and Josh Johnson makes his second straight start. A Week 13 return remains possible.

players.name: Kyler Murray
players.note: He practiced fully Friday, Nov. 27 and has no game designation for the hamstring, but he is slated to back up Kirk Cousins vs. Atlanta on Nov. 29.

players.name: Kirk Cousins
players.note: He remains Minnesota's starter for the Nov. 29 game vs. Atlanta, with Kyler Murray (cleared from his hamstring injury Friday, Nov. 27) set to serve as the backup.

players.name: Drake Maye
players.note: He is out for Week 12 with the fibula fracture he suffered Nov. 15 and has no timeline. Tommy DeVito starts Nov. 29 vs. the Chargers.

players.name: Tommy DeVito
players.note: He starts for New England on Nov. 29 vs. the Chargers with Drake Maye (fibula) out. He faces DJ Uiagalelei, since Justin Herbert was ruled out with a concussion.

players.name: Mason Rudolph
players.note: In his first start since Aaron Rodgers was released, he went 9 of 15 for 142 yards, 1 TD and 0 INT in Pittsburgh's 27-5 Black Friday win over Denver on Nov. 27 (9.7 half-PPR points). The volume was low because the Steelers led 24-5 at halftime, but the job is his.

players.name: Drew Allar
players.note: He was listed out (coach's decision) for the Nov. 27 Black Friday game, and Mason Rudolph started and won 27-5. He remains behind Rudolph.

players.name: Bo Nix
players.note: He went 22 of 40 for 169 yards with 0 TD and 2 INT in Denver's 27-5 Black Friday loss at Pittsburgh on Nov. 27 (3.5 half-PPR points). No injury was reported.

players.name: Sam Darnold
players.note: He is off the injury report and expected to start vs. San Francisco on Nov. 29. The 49ers will be without Brock Purdy (ankle).

players.name: Caleb Williams
players.note: He threw for 345 yards and 2 TD in the Nov. 26 Thanksgiving win at Detroit, then had X-rays after a late hit to the midsection; he called it a bruise. Chicago doesn't play again until Dec. 6, and Sleeper lists him as questionable.

players.name: Joe Milton
players.note: He threw for 331 yards, 3 TD and 1 INT and added a rushing TD in the Eagles' Nov. 26 Thanksgiving win over Dallas (31.7 half-PPR points). He remains Philadelphia's starter with Jalen Hurts on IR.

players.name: Jalen Hurts
players.note: He remains on IR (calf) and is expected to miss the rest of 2026. Joe Milton threw for 331 yards and 3 TD in his place on Thanksgiving (Nov. 26).

players.name: Lamar Jackson
players.note: He remains on IR after surgery on his right thumb, with a reported 6-9 week timeline. Jacoby Brissett is starting.

players.name: Jacoby Brissett
players.note: He remains Baltimore's starter while Lamar Jackson (thumb) is on IR. He threw for 276 yards, 1 TD and 1 INT on Nov. 22.

players.name: Jaxson Dart
players.note: He remains on IR after meniscus surgery on his knee and is expected to miss the rest of the regular season.

players.name: Malik Willis
players.note: He is on IR (groin) with an estimated return of Dec. 13. He should reclaim the starting job from Kyle McCord when healthy.

players.name: Kyle McCord
players.note: He is starting only while Malik Willis is on IR (estimated return Dec. 13). He threw for just 102 yards and 0 TD on Nov. 22.

players.name: Jonah Coleman
players.note: With J.K. Dobbins suspended, Coleman led Denver's backfield in the Black Friday game at Pittsburgh on Nov. 27. He ran 15 times for just 26 yards but added 8 catches for 46 yards on 10 targets.

players.name: J.K. Dobbins
players.note: Dobbins served his one-game team suspension and didn't play in Denver's Black Friday game at Pittsburgh on Nov. 27, while Jonah Coleman handled 25 touches. He's eligible to return for Week 13 but looks like the backup.

players.name: Jaylen Warren
players.note: Warren led Pittsburgh with 20 carries in the Black Friday game vs. Denver on Nov. 27, but managed only 46 yards and caught 1 pass for 0 yards, finishing with 5.1 half-PPR points.

players.name: Rico Dowdle
players.note: Dowdle out-gained Jaylen Warren on the ground in the Black Friday game vs. Denver on Nov. 27, with 11 carries for 71 yards and 1 catch for 3 yards. He's a meaningful part of Pittsburgh's committee.

players.name: Saquon Barkley
players.note: Barkley left the Thanksgiving win at Dallas on Nov. 26 with a stinger, his second of the season, after 5 carries for 7 yards, and he didn't return. Sleeper still lists him questionable (neck stinger) as of Nov. 28, and Philadelphia hasn't given a timeline for Week 13.

players.name: Emmett Johnson
players.note: With Kenneth Walker III (groin) out on Thanksgiving at Buffalo on Nov. 26, Johnson led Kansas City's backfield with 17 carries for 72 yards and a TD plus 4 catches for 24 yards.

players.name: Kenneth Walker III
players.note: Walker (groin) missed Thanksgiving at Buffalo on Nov. 26 and is still listed out on Sleeper as of Nov. 28. Emmett Johnson had 21 touches and a TD in his place, so Walker's role is uncertain even once he's healthy.

players.name: Javonte Williams
players.note: Williams handled a workhorse load in Dallas' 39-38 Thanksgiving loss to Philadelphia on Nov. 26, with 29 carries for 101 yards and 2 TDs plus 3 catches for 22 yards and a receiving TD (31.8 half-PPR points).

players.name: Blake Corum
players.note: Corum dominated the Rams' backfield on Nov. 25 vs. Green Bay with 32 carries for 184 yards and a TD plus 2 catches for 21 yards, while Kyren Williams had 12 carries.

players.name: Kyren Williams
players.note: Williams was out-carried 32 to 12 by Blake Corum on Nov. 25 vs. Green Bay. He still scored a TD and finished with 46 rushing yards and 4 catches for 19 yards, but his lead-back status is now in question.

players.name: Josh Jacobs
players.note: Jacobs (finger, post-surgery) missed the Nov. 25 game at the Rams and is still listed out on Sleeper. Kaleb Johnson managed only 32 scrimmage yards in his place, so Jacobs should reclaim the lead role once he's healthy.

players.name: Kaleb Johnson
players.note: With Josh Jacobs out on Nov. 25 at the Rams, Johnson managed just 8 carries for 13 yards and 1 catch for 19 yards. He did little to keep the job once Jacobs returns.

players.name: Bhayshul Tuten
players.note: Sleeper lists Tuten (ankle) out for Sunday's Nov. 29 game vs. Tennessee after he re-aggravated the injury.

players.name: Chris Rodriguez Jr.
players.note: With Bhayshul Tuten (ankle) listed out, Rodriguez is set to lead Jacksonville's backfield vs. Tennessee on Sunday, Nov. 29.

players.name: Derrick Henry
players.note: Henry (concussion) came off Sleeper's injury report on Nov. 27 after a full practice on Nov. 26, so he's set to play Sunday at Houston.

players.name: Woody Marks
players.note: Marks (concussion) came off Sleeper's injury report on Nov. 27 and should be available Sunday vs. Baltimore, where he'll split work with David Montgomery.

players.name: David Montgomery
players.note: Montgomery had 26 carries for 107 yards in his Week 11 return. Woody Marks cleared the injury report on Nov. 27, so he's likely to cut into Montgomery's workload Sunday vs. Baltimore.

players.name: Jeremiyah Love
players.note: Love (high ankle sprain) remains on IR as of Nov. 28. A Nov. 23 update said Week 13 is the earliest he could be activated.

players.name: Jacory Croskey-Merritt
players.note: Croskey-Merritt was activated from IR on Nov. 23 and led Washington's backfield that night with 13 carries for 54 yards and a TD plus 2 catches for 23 yards.

players.name: Rachaad White
players.note: White was active Nov. 23 vs. Cincinnati but had no carries or catches after Jacory Croskey-Merritt returned from IR.

players.name: Chase Brown
players.note: Brown had just 6 carries for 6 yards and 5 catches for 30 yards on Nov. 23, while Samaje Perine was more productive, which raises the risk of a committee.

players.name: Samaje Perine
players.note: Perine out-produced Chase Brown on Nov. 23 with 6 carries for 26 yards and 4 catches for 71 yards on roughly half the snaps.

players.name: Dylan Sampson
players.note: Sampson has out-snapped Quinshon Judkins in three straight games, so Cleveland's backfield is now a 50-50 committee. Raheim Sanders was activated from IR on Nov. 24.

players.name: Quinshon Judkins
players.note: Dylan Sampson has out-snapped Judkins in three straight games, so Cleveland's backfield is roughly a 50-50 committee and Judkins' weekly ceiling is lower.

players.name: Tony Pollard
players.note: With Tyjae Spears on IR since Nov. 21, Pollard had 21 carries for 110 yards in Week 11. He's set for a heavy workload Sunday vs. Jacksonville.

players.name: Alvin Kamara
players.note: Kamara played 8 of 72 snaps on Nov. 22 with 1 carry, while Travis Etienne Jr. took 14 carries. He has been reduced to a change-of-pace role.

players.name: Travis Etienne Jr.
players.note: Etienne led New Orleans with 14 carries for 76 yards on Nov. 22, while Alvin Kamara got 1 carry, which makes him the Saints' early-down back.

players.name: Ollie Gordon II
players.note: Gordon leads Miami's backfield with De'Von Achane out for the season (ACL), and Jaylen Wright aggravated an injury, which leaves Kaytron Allen as the main other back.

players.name: Omarion Hampton
players.note: Hampton has handled 65% and 47% of the Chargers' carries the last two weeks, and he isn't on Sleeper's injury report heading into Week 12 vs. New England.

players.name: Colston Loveland
players.note: Sleeper still lists Loveland out with the left knee injury that got him carted off in the first quarter of the Bears' Thanksgiving win over Detroit on Nov 26. He played 7 snaps and had 1 catch for 5 yards and a lost fumble, and no timetable has been given. Rookie Sam Roush played 68 snaps (5-31 on 5 targets), and Cole Kmet is already on IR.

players.name: Dallas Goedert
players.note: Goedert is still listed out with the shoulder injury he suffered in the first quarter of the Nov 26 Thanksgiving win over Dallas (9 snaps, 1 catch for 9 yards). He was seen with his right arm in a sling, and no timetable has been given.

players.name: Eli Stowers
players.note: After Goedert went down with his shoulder injury on Nov 26, Stowers played 21 offensive snaps to Zach Ertz's 29, but neither was targeted. Philadelphia's tight end snaps look split for as long as Goedert is out.

players.name: Brock Bowers
players.note: Bowers (ankle) is questionable on the final Week 12 report for Sunday against Cleveland, per Sleeper on Nov 27, after three straight limited practices. Klint Kubiak was optimistic earlier in the week, and Michael Mayer would take on more work if he sits.

players.name: Juwan Johnson
players.note: Johnson (hamstring) is ruled out for Sunday's game at Cincinnati, per Sleeper on Nov 27, after missing practice all week. Noah Fant would usually take on more work, but he is listed questionable himself.

players.name: Max Klare
players.note: Sleeper now lists Tyler Higbee out (chest) and Davis Allen questionable after both got hurt in the Rams' Nov 25 win over Green Bay. That leaves Klare and Colby Parkinson as the healthy tight ends. Klare played 43 snaps in that game but was not targeted.

players.name: Terrance Ferguson
players.note: Ferguson remains on IR and needs season-ending ankle surgery, according to Sean McVay on Nov 23.

players.name: A.J. Brown
players.note: He is officially out (hamstring) for Week 12 at the Chargers on Sleeper's final report of Nov 27. Earlier reports said he is expected to miss multiple weeks, including Week 13 vs. Buffalo.

players.name: Christian Watson
players.note: He caught 4 passes for 65 yards and a TD on Nov 25 vs. the Rams before leaving with a concussion. Sleeper lists him out (concussion) as of Nov 27 while he is in the protocol, so his Week 13 status is uncertain.

players.name: DeVonta Smith
players.note: He caught 11 of 14 targets for 200 yards and 2 TDs in the Thanksgiving win at Dallas (Nov 26). Sleeper still lists him questionable (back) as of Nov 27, so watch next week's practice reports.

players.name: Brenen Thompson
players.note: He is doubtful (hamstring) for Week 12 vs. New England on the final report of Nov 27, after missing four straight games. Justin Herbert is also out (concussion), so Jake Browning or DJ Uiagalelei would start at QB.

players.name: Jordan Addison
players.note: He is out (thumb, post-surgery) for Sunday's Week 12 game vs. Atlanta on the final report of Nov 27. That is his second straight missed game.

players.name: Denzel Boston
players.note: He goes into Sunday's Week 12 game vs. Las Vegas questionable on the final report of Nov 27, now listed with a toe injury; he missed practice Nov 25 with a quad issue. He is a true game-time decision.

players.name: Adonai Mitchell
players.note: Omar Cooper Jr. (ankle) is out for Week 12 at Miami on the final report of Nov 27. That keeps Mitchell locked in as the Jets' WR2 behind Garrett Wilson.

players.name: Jack Bech
players.note: Brock Bowers (ankle) is questionable for Week 12 at Cleveland on the final report of Nov 27, rather than out. Bech had 8 catches for 88 yards with Bowers out in Week 11, but he would lose targets if Bowers plays.

players.name: Deebo Samuel Sr.
players.note: Brock Purdy (ankle) is out for Week 12 vs. Seattle on the final report of Nov 27, so Mac Jones starts. Mike Evans is questionable (Achilles), which could add targets for Samuel but at lower QB quality.

players.name: Jalen Coker
players.note: Tetairoa McMillan is questionable (foot) for Week 12 on Carolina's final report of Nov 27, and several Panthers tight ends are also questionable. If McMillan sits, Coker would move up to the top outside receiver role.

players.name: Ja'Marr Chase
players.note: Tee Higgins is questionable (hamstring) and Andrei Iosivas went on IR (thumb) as of Nov 27. That concentrates Cincinnati's targets on Chase for Week 12.

players.name: Jalen McMillan
players.note: Sleeper lists him on IR with a PCL sprain in his knee as of Nov 27. He will miss at least the next several games.

players.name: De'Zhaun Stribling
players.note: Sleeper has him on IR after ankle surgery as of Nov 25. The rookie's 2026 season is likely in jeopardy.

players.name: Davante Adams
players.note: He remains on IR after hamstring surgery and did not play in the Rams' Nov 25 game vs. Green Bay. He has no return timeline.

players.name: Alec Pierce
players.note: He remains on IR (heel) and is out for Week 12. He said this week that he has made progress and hopes to return before the season ends.

players.name: Brandon Aiyuk
players.note: Washington signed him to its practice squad after a Nov 25 workout. He must be elevated or signed to the 53-man roster to play, and he has not played since his October 2024 ACL/MCL tear.

players.name: Michael Pittman Jr.
players.note: In his first game back from IR (foot) vs. Denver on Black Friday (Nov 27), Pittman caught 1 of 2 targets for 7 yards, a quiet return that leaves his short-term role unclear.

players.name: Roman Wilson
players.note: With Michael Pittman Jr. back vs. Denver on Black Friday (Nov 27), Wilson drew just 1 target (1-37), down from 6 targets on Nov 22.

players.name: Mike Evans
players.note: Evans (Achilles tendinitis) is still listed questionable for Week 12 on Sleeper after the Friday Nov 27 report. He had 6-109-1 on just 23 snaps on Nov 22.

players.name: Keenan Allen
players.note: Allen's role still depends on Mike Evans (Achilles), who remains questionable for Week 12 after the Friday Nov 27 report; Allen had 3-38 on 4 targets with Evans active on Nov 22.

players.name: Tee Higgins
players.note: Higgins picked up a new questionable tag (hamstring) on the Friday Nov 27 report, so his Week 12 availability is in doubt.

players.name: Tetairoa McMillan
players.note: McMillan (foot soreness) remains questionable for Week 12 on Sleeper after the Friday Nov 27 report.

players.name: Omar Cooper Jr.
players.note: Cooper (ankle, his third ankle injury this year) has been ruled out for Week 12 per Sleeper as of Nov 27, his second straight missed game.

players.name: Parker Washington
players.note: Washington (shoulder) has been ruled out for Week 12 per Sleeper as of Nov 27, one week after he drew 17 targets (8-103) on Nov 22.

players.name: Josh Cameron
players.note: With Parker Washington (shoulder) ruled out for Week 12 as of Nov 27, the 17 targets Washington drew on Nov 22 leave room for Cameron's Sunday role to grow.

players.name: Zachariah Branch
players.note: Branch (hamstring) has been ruled out for Week 12 per Sleeper as of Nov 27, which will be his fourth straight missed game.

players.name: Marvin Harrison Jr.
players.note: Harrison (hamstring) has no designation after the Friday Nov 27 report and is on track to return for Sunday's Week 12 game after missing Week 11.

players.name: Tank Dell
players.note: Marvin Harrison Jr. carries no injury designation into Week 12 after the Nov 27 report, so Dell's extra Week 11 volume is likely to shrink.

players.name: Romeo Doubs
players.note: Doubs (shoulder) is still on IR on Sleeper as of Nov 28; no activation has been reported for Week 12.

players.name: Puka Nacua
players.note: Nacua (MCL surgery) remains on IR facing a four-to-five-month recovery. He did not play in the Rams' Nov 25 game, and the team is planning without him for the rest of 2026.

players.name: Michael Wilson
players.note: Wilson remains on IR as of Nov 28, out for the season with the neck fracture he suffered Nov 8.

players.name: Terry McLaurin
players.note: McLaurin remains on IR as of Nov 28, out for 2026 after tearing his patellar tendon on Oct 19.

players.name: Ricky Pearsall
players.note: Pearsall (knee/PCL) remains on IR as of Nov 28 and is out for the season.
